question: The largest wind farm cluster of India is located in ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **largest wind energy cluster **is found in** Tamil Nadu's Kanyakumari district**.
 
• **Muppandal Wind Farm **is the name given to it.
 
• With a **1500 MW capacity**, it is the third-largest operating onshore wind farm in the world.
 
• Wind parks, wind power plants, and wind power stations are other names for wind farms. 
 
• The wind is a **low-cost, dependable**, and c**lean energy source** that can be used to create power.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Important wind farms are also located in **Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka, Gujarat, Kerala, Maharashtra, and Lakshadweep.**
 
• Wind energy is used by **windmills**.
 
• In steep areas, open meadows, or coastal areas, wind farms are erected. India is the fifth-largest country in the world after Germany, Denmark, the USA, Spain, and the UK.
 
• The largest cluster of wind farms in India is located in Tamil Nadu, between Nagercoil and Madurai. Additionally, Gujarat, Karnataka, and Kerala. Maharashtra and Lakshadweep both have significant wind farms.
